description: The drawing, titled "Diagram 4.1 Treatments for material change of use", comprises four separate sections stacked vertically, each with a label beneath. The first, "Wall treatment 1", is a vertical section through a wall, shown as a long hatched column, with two triangular brackets, each marked with a cross, projecting from its left face. The second, "Floor treatment 1", is a horizontal section showing a row of upright loop-shaped elements resting on a flat base, bounded at each end by a crossed triangular bracket. The third, "Floor treatment 2", is a horizontal section of a thin profile with a hatched strip along its lower edge. The fourth, "Stair treatment 1", is a section through three steps, with a diagonal lattice element running along the slope beneath them and a short horizontal line at the top step.
